**Mont Ventoux Observatory – Handover Summary (≈150 words)**  

- Telescopes: 60‑cm reflector (installed 2017) and 20‑cm outreach refractor.  
- Night use: ~195 useful nights / yr (168 in 2024).  
- Data flow: ~400 GB per night (≈400 GB / month) transferred to Marseille in ~40 min.  
- Camera upgrade: Main camera replaced March 2025, read‑noise reduced by ~30 %; a full‑night offline firmware update is required.  
- Past incidents: 2023 dome‑motor seizure bent the counterweight rod (repaired; limit switch added). February 2025 a 1.2 s timestamp offset went unnoticed, losing three weeks of photometry; all sessions are now GPS‑checked.  
- Operational rules: No observing on outreach evenings; acquisition‑software changes must be tested on a dedicated night. Raw frames are compressed; deletion policy is **uncertain** (some notes say “never deleted”, others “compressed after two years”).  
- Collaboration: Spanish team awaiting review/evaluation of a shared scheduling tool; simultaneous‑transfer network capacity is **uncertain**.
